results.title: LoP Sunil Sharma meets LG, seeks justice for left-out sportspersons
results.description: Leader of Opposition in the Jammu & Kashmir Legislative Assembly, Sunil Sharma, along with Billawar MLA Satish Sharma, on Friday met Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha and discussed a range of issues related to sports, religious affairs, infrastructure development and public welfare in the Union Territory. During the meeting, the BJP leaders raised concerns over the reported exclusion of several accomplished sportspersons from Jammu and Kashmir from the recently announced selection list. They specifically highlighted the cases of deserving para-athletes and Arjuna Award recipients, stating that these athletes have brought laurels to both Jammu and Kashmir and the country through their achievements. The delegation urged the Lieutenant Governor to ensure that all deserving sportspersons are duly recognised and provided the benefits, support and opportunities they rightfully deserve. The leaders also took up issues concerning the Shri Sukrala Mata Shrine Board, stressing the need to strengthen the Board and undertake measures to improve infrastructure and pilgrim amenities. They said better facilities and planned development would help establish the shrine as a major religious and tourism destination in the region. In addition, Sharma and Satish Sharma apprised the Lieutenant Governor of several issues concerning infrastructure development, public welfare, tourism, road connectivity and the timely execution of ongoing developmental projects across different parts of Jammu and Kashmir. They sought expeditious intervention to ensure that development projects are completed without delay and that the benefits of development reach all regions of the Union Territory in a balanced and inclusive manner. The delegation emphasised that improved infrastructure, enhanced connectivity and accelerated implementation of public projects are essential for promoting economic growth, boosting tourism and improving the quality of life of the people. Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha gave a patient hearing to the issues raised by the delegation and assured them that all genuine concerns would be examined on priority. He also assured the leaders that appropriate directions would be issued to the concerned departments to facilitate timely action. Following the meeting, Sunil Sharma thanked the Lieutenant Governor for his positive response and expressed confidence that the issues highlighted by the delegation, particularly those concerning deserving sportspersons, the development of the Shri Sukrala Mata Shrine Board and the acceleration of developmental works, would receive due consideration in the larger interest of the people of Jammu and Kashmir.

results.title: Ariz. Governor’s Race: Gov. Hobbs declines to debate GOP contender Rep. Andy Biggs
results.description: Arizona Democrat Governor Katie Hobbs will not participate in general election debates against her Republican challenger, Representative Andy Biggs -- marking the second consecutive gubernatorial election in which the Democrat incumbent has opted to bypass the traditional debate stage.

results.title: Hochul lets bill forcing embattled ACS to turn over records languish as another child dies in Bronx hellhole
results.description: The legislation requiring ACS officials to cough up records to the city's Department of Investigation still awaits Hochul's signature or veto even after state lawmakers approved it in June.
